definition.name: Burning Cape
definition.text: Burns enemies within 650 for 60 magic damage per second (Fire).

definition.name: Crash Knife
definition.text: Jump up to 1200 (as the Jump Knife). Where you land, enemies within 800 take 100 + 50% of your strength as magic damage, then another 100% of your strength over 6 seconds, and move 50% and attack 50 slower for 6 seconds.

definition.name: Blast Rod
definition.text: Blast an enemy within 640 with 400 magic damage at once. Buy the recipe again to raise its level (up to 5).

definition.name: Blast Rod 2
definition.text: Blast an enemy within 640 with 500 magic damage at once. Buy the recipe again to raise its level (up to 5).

definition.name: Blast Rod 3
definition.text: Blast an enemy within 640 with 600 magic damage at once. Buy the recipe again to raise its level (up to 5).

definition.name: Blast Rod 4
definition.text: Blast an enemy within 640 with 700 magic damage at once. Buy the recipe again to raise its level (up to 5).

definition.name: Blast Rod 5
definition.text: Blast an enemy within 640 with 800 magic damage at once. Buy the recipe again to raise its level (up to 5).

definition.name: Frost Plate
definition.text: A ring of frost spreads out to 825: enemies it reaches take 225 magic damage and move 40% slower for 4 seconds. Costs 75 mana, 27 second cooldown.

definition.name: Giant Heart
definition.text: Regenerates 1% of your maximum health and 1.5% of your missing health every second.

definition.name: Guard Boots
definition.text: Mend: heal yourself and allies within 1200 for 325 health and 200 mana, and remove your own debuffs (a basic dispel). 45 second cooldown. Aura: +2.5 health regen (+17 below 25% health) and +1.5 mana regen.

definition.name: Leech Blade
definition.text: Blood Rage: +145% lifesteal for 6 seconds. 40 second cooldown.

definition.name: Long Lens
definition.text: +225 cast range for spells and items. A second Long Lens adds half as much, a third a quarter.

definition.name: Net Staff
definition.text: Throw nets at every enemy in a 325 area within 1100: each one hit cannot move for 2 seconds. Costs 150 mana, 18 second cooldown.

definition.name: Refresh Stone
definition.text: Finish the cooldowns of all your spells at once (not items). Costs 325 mana, 180 second cooldown.

definition.name: Storm Hammer
definition.text: Static Charge: for 12 seconds an ally (or yourself) has a 20% chance when attacked to strike up to 4 enemies within 900 with lightning for 225 magic damage (the attacker first). Costs 50 mana, 35 second cooldown.

definition.name: Team Shield
definition.text: Guard: for 7 seconds you and allies within 1200 block 70 damage (+2% of your max health) from every attack. Costs 75 mana, 40 second cooldown.

definition.name: Time Crystal
definition.text: Your spells and items cool down 25% faster (several of these do not stack).

definition.name: Travel Boots
definition.text: Teleport without a scroll (Teleport key or the Teleport slot) to any allied building or creep. 40 second cooldown.

definition.name: War Drum
definition.text: Endurance: you and allies within 1200 get +35 attack speed and 13% more speed for 6 seconds. 45 second cooldown. Aura: +15 movement speed and +2.5 health regen.

definition.desc: Gancho wakes the forest for 7 seconds. Every second each tree within 1000 of him lashes the nearest enemy within 350 of it with a vine: 35 / 50 / 65 magic damage and a 0.4 second root (a unit is rooted at most once every 1.5 seconds, and takes at most two lashes a second). Gancho attacks 30 / 45 / 60 faster meanwhile.
definition.name: Angry Forest

definition.desc: Roydo becomes the Anomaly, a hulking monster, for 30 seconds: his base attack time is 0.25 seconds shorter, he deals 60 / 120 / 180 more attack damage and he attacks from range (650).
definition.name: Anomaly

definition.desc: Burak throws an axe up to 1000. The first enemy hit takes physical damage and is slowed by 30% for 2 seconds; the axe sticks in it, or in the first tree or cliff, or drops at the end. For 4 seconds he can cast it again for free to leap to the axe, landing beside it and attacking at once. Walking over a dropped axe picks it up and halves the cooldown left. While the axe is gone he deals 20% less attack damage. A hero hit gives 15 Rage. Upgrade Staff: both axes fly in a fork; he can leap to either.
definition.name: Axe Throw

definition.desc: Ghorman becomes a huge beast for 25 seconds: 300 / 600 / 900 more health, 40 / 60 / 80 more attack damage and 40 more speed; every 3rd attack is a maul for 100 / 150 / 200 more physical damage and a 0.6 second bash. His beasts grow too: 25% more health, and their abilities come back 25% faster.
definition.name: Beast Form

definition.desc: For 12 seconds Burak's Rage stays full, he deals 40 / 60 / 80 more attack damage, moves 10% faster and slows do nothing to him. Half of the damage he takes is held back and comes back as pure damage over 6 seconds after Berserk ends. Every enemy hero he kills or helps kill during Berserk clears the held damage.
definition.name: Berserk

definition.desc: Ghorman blesses one of his beasts: it heals 30 / 40 / 50 / 60% of its health, is cleansed of slows, silences and roots, its ability is ready again, and for 8 seconds it deals 20 / 30 / 40 / 50% more attack damage and attacks 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 faster.
definition.name: Blessing of the Beast King

definition.desc: Jayla gives in to the hunt: for 15 seconds her attacks steal life and reach much further. When an attack hits her she may leap back out of reach.
definition.name: Blood Ranger

definition.desc: Sludge's fat thickens: every instance of damage he takes, from any source, is reduced by a flat amount for a few seconds. Does not interrupt Chomp.
definition.name: Blubber

definition.desc: Araki dashes up to 600 like a flash and slashes every enemy within 250 of his path: each one takes an attack (critical strikes, bashes and every other attack effect can happen) and 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 magic damage, and is slowed by 60% for 1 second. If he hits any enemy unit, Blur Strike's cooldown is refreshed once: he can dash a second time within 6 seconds.
definition.name: Blur Strike

definition.desc: Blau fires a magic bullet toward the target point. It passes through enemies and ricochets off trees, walls, boulders and other units, up to 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 times; each ricochet lets it fly 400 further. A tree it ricochets off is knocked down. Each enemy it passes takes magic damage, at most twice.
definition.name: Bounce Shot

definition.desc: Froster breathes a cone of bitter cold up to 800 ahead. Every enemy in it takes magic damage and is slowed for 3 seconds.
definition.name: Breath of Cold

definition.desc: Jayla plants her feet and looses 30 arrows over five waves of four to seven into the target area. Each arrow strikes a random enemy there for a share of her attack damage. Channelled: moving, attacking, stopping, a stun, silence or a push ends it.
definition.name: Burst Shot

definition.desc: Lord Kaileh charges up to 1600 with six ghost riders at his sides, trampling the trees in his way. Enemies in the 400 wide path take 200 / 300 / 400 magic damage, are pushed aside and stunned for 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 seconds. Nothing can slow or move him while he charges.
definition.name: Cavalry Charge

definition.desc: Each use changes Dracoxinia's sword to the next one (1 second apart, no mana): 3 / 4 / 5 swords in the order Pink, Gold, Blue, Red, Green. Her attacks take the sword's element (Pink Lightning, Gold Light, Blue Water, Red Fire, Green Nature), and her next attack after a change is a Dragon Blade strike (at most once every 6 / 5 / 4 seconds).
definition.name: Change Sword

definition.desc: Sludge grabs an enemy and eats it alive. Channelled for 2.75 seconds: the victim is stunned and pulled in, taking magic damage that grows with his strength, and Sludge heals for all of it.
definition.name: Chomp

definition.desc: Damage Roydo takes has a 9 / 13 / 17 / 21% chance to burst back out: 25 / 28 / 31 / 34% of it hits every enemy within 650 as magic damage and slows their movement and attacks by 80% for 0.3 seconds.
definition.name: Dark Matter Skin

definition.desc: Ezee slams the ground with unholy force, damaging nearby enemies and hurling them away. Enemies that crash into a unit, tree, cliff or wall take impact damage and are stunned.
definition.name: Dark Stomp

definition.desc: Caziel strikes hardest when an enemy is about to die: his attacks deal pure damage to enemies below 10 / 12 / 14% health.
definition.name: Death Order

definition.desc: Azrael's attacks and spells have a chance to strike as pure damage, adding bonus pure damage and healing her for 50% of the damage done. 1 second cooldown after each strike.
definition.name: Death Scythe

definition.desc: Azrael spreads her white wings for 25 seconds: she flies over cliffs and trees, moves 15% faster, sees further day and night and attacks faster. Enemies within 700 of her lose part of their sight.
definition.name: Divine Darkness

definition.desc: Azrin hurls a burning hammer at an enemy. It strikes for 250 plus twice her intelligence as magic damage and sets the ground around it alight: every Fire burn on enemies there lasts longer.
definition.name: Divine Smite

definition.desc: Every spell Thyrandael casts gives him a charge of Divine Touch: an All-damage Barrier as large as his intelligence (it takes damage of every kind before his health). Up to 3 charges; the barrier fades 12 seconds after his last spell.
definition.name: Divine Touch

definition.desc: Araki throws a bomb that sets a demon loose in a cloud of smoke (radius 450) for 5 seconds. Enemies inside lose 10 / 15 / 20 / 25% magic resistance and 10 / 15 / 20 / 25% status resistance, and are slowed by 5 / 8 / 11 / 14% more for every second they stay in it.
definition.name: Djin Bomb

definition.desc: Azrael opens a door to the spirit world. She and up to two allied heroes can walk into it, hidden and unharmed, and may move to step out early without setting off the blast. Cast again to place the exit, up to 800 away. When the door closes, everyone inside steps out in a spirit blast that heals nearby allies, deals magic damage to enemies, stuns them for 1 second, and strips their elemental resistances for 4 seconds.
definition.name: Door of the End

definition.desc: Every 4th attack is a heavy strike with 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 more damage and her sword's power. Pink: lightning jumps to 3 more enemies within 500 for 60% of the strike. Gold: an All-damage Barrier as large as the strike for 6 seconds. Blue: the target is rooted for 0.6 seconds and slowed by 40% for 2 seconds. Red: every enemy within 250 of the target takes the strike too, and all of them burn for 30 a second for 3 seconds. Green: she heals 60% of the strike.
definition.name: Dragon Blade

definition.desc: Dracoxinia dashes up to 650 through her enemies: each takes 70 / 130 / 190 / 250 physical damage and is slowed by 50% for 0.5 seconds.
definition.name: Dragon Dash

definition.desc: Dracoxinia's scales harden: 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 more armor and 1.5 / 3 / 4.5 / 6 more health regeneration.
definition.name: Dragon Hide

definition.desc: Dracoxinia leaps to a point up to 500 / 550 / 600 / 650 away, over trees and cliffs, 0.55 seconds in the air. She cannot leap while rooted.
definition.name: Dragon Leap

definition.desc: Froster stands still and calls a blizzard for up to 7 seconds. Enemies within 600 take magic damage every second; one that stays inside for 2 seconds is Frosted, frozen solid for 2 seconds (once every 1.5 seconds after that). Channelled.
definition.name: Endless Winter

definition.desc: Thyrandael gains a charge for every 300 / 250 / 200 damage he takes, up to 10 / 11 / 12. He spends them all on a violent burst of light at a spot (400): for 5 seconds enemies miss up to 40 / 70 / 100% of their attacks, are slowed by up to 55% and take up to 60 / 80 / 100 magic damage a second, each by the share of charges he held. Its range (up to 800 / 1200 / 1600) also follows the charges, and its cooldown runs from 10 / 9 / 8 seconds down to 6 / 5 / 4 at full charges. Needs a charge.
definition.name: False Judgement

definition.desc: Winds an ally (or Tock) forward: 2 / 3.5 / 5 / 6.5 seconds come off the cooldowns of its basic spells (not its ultimate, not items), and it moves 10 / 14 / 18 / 22% faster for 5 seconds.
definition.name: Fast Forward

definition.desc: Blackfire's great sword is corrupted with the Underworld: a 10 / 15 / 20 / 25% chance to strike a critical hit for 2x damage. A critical hit heals every ally within 800 (Blackfire too) for 20 / 25 / 30 / 35% of its damage.
definition.name: Fiend Edge

definition.desc: Azrin hurls a great flaming javelin up to 1000 range. Every enemy near its path is caught and dragged along to where it lands, and burns for magic damage every second for 5 seconds. Trees in its path are knocked down.
definition.name: Fiery Javelin

definition.desc: Damage Froster deals to enemies builds a Frost Heart (one per 500 / 450 / 400 / 350 damage, up to 3). His next attack spends one: 200 extra magic damage and a 40% slow for 1.5 seconds.
definition.name: Frost Heart

definition.desc: Looses a great arrow toward the target point; it always flies its full 2000 range. Every enemy it passes is struck for magic damage and hurled aside; an enemy that crashes into a wall, unit, building or tree takes another 20% of that damage. The arrow fells every tree in its path, and so do the units it throws.
definition.name: Gale Impact

definition.desc: Araki calls 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 ghosts from the Undead realm, one every 0.3 seconds. Each flies out at 800 (through units, over cliffs and trees) and strikes the target the moment it reaches it, even on the run, for 25 / 35 / 45 / 55% of Araki's attack damage, then vanishes. Their hits add Senryukai stacks and renew them. One hit destroys a ghost. If the target dies, the ghosts left go for the nearest enemy.
definition.name: Ghosts of the Will

definition.desc: Ser Emelrich winds up for 1.8 / 1.6 / 1.4 seconds (a red cone for everyone to see: get out of it), then brings the sword down through a cone 700 long and 100 degrees wide: 250 / 375 / 500 physical damage that ignores 65% of armor, and every enemy hit is knocked down (stunned) for 2.5 / 3.5 / 4.5 seconds. Every tree in the cone falls. While he winds up he has Spell Immunity: the debuffs on him are removed and no new one lands, so nothing but death stops the swing. Upgrade Staff: 0.5 seconds later he swings back the other way (a smaller cone, half damage).
definition.name: Giant Swing

definition.desc: Roydo's gravity seizes one unit in a 400 area, enemy heroes first, and throws it to the middle over 0.8 seconds. Then every enemy there takes magic damage and is stunned for 1 second. With no enemy in the area, an ally is thrown instead and comes to no harm.
definition.name: Grip of the Ruler

definition.desc: Sludge gains 2 strength for good whenever an enemy hero dies within 450 of him, or anywhere if he gets the kill.
definition.name: Growing Gut

definition.desc: A blast of wind rushes 900 ahead, then turns back to Airah wherever she is. Every enemy it hits takes magic damage and is dragged along toward its head; enemies can still move and act, and can pull free by walking away. An enemy dragged into a tree, cliff, building or unit takes more damage. Trees it hits fall.
definition.name: Gust

definition.desc: Thyrandael shoots a beam of light 800 long for up to 7 seconds. Enemies in the beam take 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 magic damage and lose 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 mana every second, and are slowed by 30% while it touches them. He cannot move while he holds it; a move order turns him (60% slower than usual) and the beam turns with him. Press S (Stop) to end it.
definition.name: Holy Beam

definition.desc: A hurricane 450 wide for 6 seconds; Airah keeps moving and casting. Trees inside fall. Enemies inside are dragged toward its middle and take magic damage every second; allies inside move 25% faster. When it ends, every enemy still inside is thrown 450 straight out, and one that crashes into a tree, cliff, building or unit is stunned for 1 second.
definition.name: Hurricane

definition.desc: Curses an enemy: its defense drops (armor and every resistance count less, so it takes more physical and magic damage) for 3.5 seconds. Then the curse bursts in an ice blast that deals 100 magic damage to it and every enemy within 300.
definition.name: Ice Pulse

definition.desc: Kragg magnetizes an enemy: the two snap together and meet halfway. The enemy takes magic damage, is stunned and gets 2 Charges.
definition.name: Iron Grip

definition.desc: Feran throws a box that lands and pops after a 0.8 second fuse: enemies within 275 take magic damage and each rolls its own prank. Pie: its attacks miss half the time for 3 seconds. Spring: thrown 350 in a random direction (a crash into a tree, cliff or unit stuns for 0.6 seconds). Confetti: silenced. Glue: rooted.
definition.name: Joke Box

definition.desc: Feran throws 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 knives 0.1 seconds apart, each at a random angle within 25 degrees of his aim, 800 far. Each knife deals magic damage to the first enemy it hits; one enemy is hit by at most 5 knives a cast.
definition.name: Knife Juggle

definition.desc: Lord Kaileh lowers his lance and charges up to 700 / 800 / 900 / 1000. The first enemy hero he meets is carried on the lance to the end of the charge, takes 75 / 150 / 225 / 300 physical damage and is stunned for 1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 seconds. Other enemies in his way take the damage and are pushed aside.
definition.name: Lance Charge

definition.desc: Lord Kaileh swings his lance round him (350): enemies take 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 physical damage, are pushed 150 away and slowed by 30% for 2 seconds.
definition.name: Lance Sweep

definition.desc: Blau leaps 400 backwards and leaves a hidden trap where he stood. The first enemy to step on it is caught and cannot move for 1.2 / 1.6 / 2 / 2.4 seconds. The trap lasts 25 seconds.
definition.name: Lay Trap

definition.desc: Ezee picks the visible enemy in range with the lowest health (the nearest one if none is hurt), leaps onto it and strikes for pure damage plus 60% of his strength, slowing it. Does nothing if no enemy is in sight.
definition.name: Leap Strike

definition.desc: For 6 seconds Kragg is a giant magnet: enemies within 700 are dragged toward him (harder with each Charge) and gain a Charge every second. When it ends, enemies within 300 take magic damage and are stunned.
definition.name: Magnet Field

definition.desc: Kragg's attacks give enemies a Charge (up to 4, for 8 seconds). Each Charge makes the enemy take 0.10% more damage from his spells, +0.05% per hero level.
definition.name: Magnetize

definition.desc: Caziel wraps himself in shadows for 12 seconds: he vanishes from the enemy minimap, evades attacks more often and moves faster.
definition.name: Master of Shadows

definition.desc: Her attacks have a chance to burst for bonus physical damage based on her agility. Cooldown after each burst.
definition.name: Masterful Archery

definition.desc: Lord Kaileh hits harder the faster he moves: 30% of his bonus movement speed is added to his attack damage.
definition.name: Momentum

definition.desc: Ser Emelrich raises his sword (this part can still be called off), then winds up for 0.6 seconds with a red line on the ground for everyone to see; from then on only a stun, hex or silence stops the swing. The cut, 450 long and 160 wide, deals physical damage plus 60% of his attack damage and stuns. Trees on the line fall.
definition.name: Overhead Cut

definition.desc: Every 6th / 5th / 4th / 3rd attack, Kragg overloads and bursts electric charge around him: enemies within 200 are slowed by 80% for 0.8 seconds and take 60 / 75 / 90 / 105 electric magic damage (Lightning element).
definition.name: Overload

definition.desc: Each of his beasts within 900 gives Ghorman 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 attack damage and 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 armor. When one of his beasts dies, he heals 8 / 10 / 12 / 14% of his health.
definition.name: Pack Leader

definition.desc: Upgrade Staff: Blau climbs into one of his turrets and pilots it. The turret gains 300 / 600 / 900 health and shoots what Blau attacks; Blau cannot be hurt inside and still attacks and casts from it. Cast again or move to get out. 5 second cooldown to get in.
definition.name: Pilot Turret

definition.desc: Blau builds a turret that shoots enemies within 650 every 1.5 seconds for 25 / 30 / 35% of his attack damage (40% at level 3 with the Upgrade Staff); his attack effects work with its shots. It has 900 / 1500 / 2100 health, no regeneration and lasts 35 seconds.
definition.name: Place Turret

definition.desc: A quick blast of light around Thyrandael (500): 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 magic damage, and a mark on every enemy hit for 10 seconds. The marks stack and renew: each mark an enemy already has adds 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 magic damage to the next Quick Flash. It does not stop Holy Beam.
definition.name: Quick Flash

definition.desc: Every spell Tock casts takes 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 seconds off the cooldowns of his other spells.
definition.name: Quick Hands

definition.desc: Burak fills with Rage (up to 100): 1 for every 1% of his health he loses and 5 for every attack he lands on a hero. After 4 seconds without hitting or being hit by a hero he loses 10 a second. Every 10 Rage gives him 5 attack speed (50 when full).
definition.name: Rage

definition.desc: For 8 seconds Burak's attacks cleave 50 / 60 / 70 / 80% of their damage to the enemies behind his target and heal him for 15 / 20 / 25 / 30% of the damage, but he takes 15% more damage.
definition.name: Reckless Swing

definition.desc: A magnetic blast throws enemies near Kragg away, 25% further for each Charge they carry, and slows them. One that crashes into a tree, wall or unit takes more damage and is stunned. Adds a Charge.
definition.name: Repel

definition.desc: Tock steps back to where he stood 3 seconds ago, with the health and mana he had then if he had more. Removes slows and silences (a basic dispel) and dodges projectiles on the way.
definition.name: Rewind

definition.desc: Blackfire lets out a deafening roar: the fresh bodies within 1000 rise at once as his Undead for 20 seconds, his to command. The roar stays on him for 20 seconds and raises whatever dies within 1000 meanwhile; the raised stay their 20 seconds after it ends. Ancient creeps, heroes, buildings, summoned units and tamed beasts do not rise. The Undead give no gold or experience.
definition.name: Rise Up

definition.desc: Dracoxinia slashes upward and throws an enemy into the air for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 / 1.4 seconds (it is stunned there), with 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 physical damage.
definition.name: Rising Slash

definition.desc: Enemies within 500 are slowed by 35 / 40 / 45 / 50% and deal 15 / 20 / 25 / 30% less attack damage for 6 seconds. His beasts within 900 attack 30 faster (and 2% more for each beast he leads) and move 20% faster for 6 seconds.
definition.name: Roar

definition.desc: Gancho throws a living vine 1100 far. The first enemy it touches takes 80 / 140 / 200 / 260 magic damage and is rooted for 1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 seconds.
definition.name: Root Snare

definition.desc: Dracoxinia takes 15% less damage from enemies whose element her sword beats.
definition.name: Royal Scales

definition.desc: Blackfire grips an enemy unit with the Underworld: the target and Blackfire are both stunned for 2 / 2.2 / 2.4 / 2.6 seconds, and the target loses 25% of its current health as pure damage (this never kills). After the stun both deal 30% less attack damage for 2 seconds. Meanwhile his Undead go for the target first.
definition.name: Sacrificial Grip

definition.desc: Gancho throws a seed. It bursts 0.6 seconds after it lands: enemies within 250 take 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 magic damage and are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds, and a young tree grows where it burst for 15 seconds.
definition.name: Seed Bomb

definition.desc: Araki's katana grows sharper the longer the fight goes on. Each of his attacks (and his ghosts') on an enemy adds a stack: every stack deals 4 more physical damage on his hits on that enemy. The stacks last 15 seconds, renewed with every hit. Not on buildings.
definition.name: Senryukai

definition.desc: Every enemy hero and creep in the area trades places with another random enemy there, is stunned, then is dizzy for 3 seconds (turns half as fast and moves 25% slower). Then knives fly out of the middle in every direction: 6 Knife Juggles at its level, each hitting one enemy at most 5 times. With one enemy inside, it trades places with Feran instead.
definition.name: Shuffle

definition.desc: Sludge hurls a chain tipped with a spinning shuriken. It always flies its full 1300 range and catches the first unit it touches, dragging it back to where he threw it. Enemies take pure damage and are stunned while dragged; enemy creeps die at once; allies are pulled to safety unharmed. The chain flies over cliffs and trees.
definition.name: Shuriken Hook

definition.desc: A field of slowed time for 5 seconds: enemies inside move 30 / 35 / 40 / 45% slower and attack slower.
definition.name: Slow Field

definition.desc: Raises its club for 2.8 seconds, then smashes the ground: enemies in the area take magic damage and are stunned.
definition.name: Smash

definition.desc: The wolf snarls: nearby enemies deal 60% less attack damage for 4 seconds.
definition.name: Snarl

definition.desc: Toggle. Every 4.5 seconds Azrael scans 600 around her for souls (every unit but herself, allies and enemies alike). If at least one unit is found, it spends 80 mana and grants bonus attack damage on her next strike for each unit and each hero scanned. Her next attack deals pure damage in a 100% cleave over a 400 area, slowing hit enemies by 80% for 0.8 seconds.
definition.name: Soul Tap

definition.desc: Every spell Azrin casts adds a spirit of fire circling her, up to 5. Shoot them all at a 250 area: each spirit burns the enemies there for magic damage over 5 seconds, and they are slowed while they burn.
definition.name: Spirit of Fire

definition.desc: Thyrandael steps to the target spot at once and stomps the ground with divine light: enemies within 300 are silenced for 1 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 seconds and slowed by 40% for 1 second.
definition.name: Spirit Step

definition.desc: Toggle (1 second between toggles). While on, Ser Emelrich moves 20% slower and turns half as fast, but has 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 more armor and takes 25 / 35 / 45 / 55% less damage from attacks and line shots that come from his front 120 degrees. Other slows do nothing to him. How he faces matters.
definition.name: Steel Stance

definition.desc: A toxic cloud pours off Sludge, damaging and slowing nearby enemies, and hurting Sludge himself (it can never kill him). Toggle it on and off. Keeps working while he is stunned.
definition.name: Stench

definition.desc: Stomps the ground: enemies nearby take magic damage and are stunned (1.6 s heroes, 3 s others).
definition.name: Stomp

definition.desc: Time stops in a 400 area: every enemy there is frozen (stunned) and its cooldowns stand still for 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 seconds. Tock's allies keep moving.
definition.name: Stop Time

definition.desc: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 boulders roll out toward the target point at random angles, as far as it (at most 700), bouncing off each other, walls and units. An enemy they hit takes magic damage once and is knocked 200 back. They stay for 10 seconds and block every unit, even phased ones. Bounce Shot ricochets off them.
definition.name: Summon Boulders

definition.desc: Feran and any hero, ally or enemy, trade places at once; projectiles aimed at either of them miss. A swapped enemy is turned to face away and slowed by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Upgrade Staff: cast it on an allied hero to mark it, then on an enemy hero: those two trade places and Feran stays put.
definition.name: Swap

definition.desc: A wide swing through the half circle in front of him (300): his attack damage plus 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 as physical damage. Enemies hit are shoved 200 to his left, so they pile up; one shoved into a tree, cliff, building or unit takes 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 more and is stunned for 0.5 seconds.
definition.name: Sweep

definition.desc: Each attack has a chance to land a second, poisoned blow: the target takes poison damage every second for 2 seconds. A new poison renews the old one; they do not stack.
definition.name: Sweet Poison

definition.desc: Caziel flashes to an enemy in a trail of shadows and stabs it at once with his attack plus bonus physical damage, cutting its armor for 3 seconds.
definition.name: Swift Dagger

definition.desc: Wind at an ally's back (or Airah's) for 5 seconds: it moves 16 / 22 / 28 / 34% faster, walks through units, and ranged attacks against it miss 25 / 30 / 35 / 40% of the time. Removes slows when cast.
definition.name: Tailwind

definition.desc: Purple lightning from the sky enchants Ezee's sword. His attacks deal bonus magic damage and curse the target, revealing it and granting sight around it, even through invisibility.
definition.name: Tainted Touch

definition.desc: A neutral creep (not from the ancient camp) or an enemy lane creep becomes Ghorman's beast for good, with 20 / 30 / 40 / 50% more health and attack damage, and keeps its own ability. He can lead 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 at once; taming past that releases the oldest (it dies). Upgrade Staff: ancient creeps too, one of them at a time.
definition.name: Tame

definition.desc: Araki falls into complete concentration for 19 seconds: Blur Strike and Djin Bomb have half their cooldowns (the ones already running are halved too), and his next 9 / 15 / 21 attacks are 60 / 80 / 100 faster.
definition.name: The Blur

definition.desc: Each of Gancho's attacks leaves a thorn in the enemy for 5 seconds (up to 5; a new one renews them all). Each thorn deals 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 magic damage a second and slows by 4%.
definition.name: Thorn Barbs

definition.desc: Tock fires a bolt of slowed time up to 1000 ahead. Every enemy it passes takes magic damage, and for 4 seconds its spell and item cooldowns run 30 / 40 / 50 / 60% slower.
definition.name: Time Bolt

definition.desc: Spirit flames burst over a 300 area: enemies take 100 magic damage and carry the flames. When one of them casts a spell, or after 4 seconds, the flames explode for more magic damage and stun it.
definition.name: Touch of Ember

definition.desc: Gancho walks through trees as if they were open ground, and has 20% evasion while he stands within 250 of a tree.
definition.name: Tree Walk

definition.desc: Every unit that dies within 1000 of Blackfire gives its soul to him: he heals 4% of his maximum health, 10% for a hero (150% more).
definition.name: Underworld Presence

definition.desc: Blackfire cannot stay dead. When he dies he lies still for 3 seconds, then springs back to life with full health and 25% more damage, armor, movement speed and attack speed for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds, and then dies for good (sooner if he is killed again). As his life ends he lets out a blast: every unit within 400, allies too, is thrown 300 away from him, and any that slams into a wall, a tree or another unit is stunned for 0.5 seconds.
definition.name: Unfallen

definition.desc: Ezee roars and is wrapped in a dark aura. Each instance of damage he takes has a chance to be halved, the other half striking a random nearby enemy as pure damage. When the aura fades he is slowed for 2 seconds.
definition.name: Unholy Might

definition.desc: When a stun, root or hex lands on Burak while he has 40 Rage or more, he spends 40 Rage and it lasts 40 / 50 / 60 / 70% shorter. Break stops it.
definition.name: Unstoppable

definition.desc: A wave of gravity rolls out 650 around Roydo for 7 seconds. Enemies lose 20 / 30 / 40 / 50% status resistance and deal 10 / 15 / 20 / 25% less damage. Allies gain 7 / 9 / 11 / 13 armor and move 7 / 9 / 11 / 13% faster.
definition.name: Void Rush

definition.desc: Lord Kaileh plants his house banner for 12 seconds. Allies within 600 have 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 more armor and attack 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 faster; enemies within 600 move 10% slower. Four attacks bring it down; spells do not hurt it.
definition.name: War Banner

definition.desc: A wall of wind 600 wide rises across Airah's aim for 4 / 4.5 / 5 / 5.5 seconds. Enemy ranged attacks that touch it stop. Enemies walking through it are slowed by 30%.
definition.name: Wind Wall
